name: Sound Vortex
description: Gesture-controlled music visualization. Hand motion and rhythm drive a particle vortex in TouchDesigner, where the swirl breathes with the beat while gestures steer its form in real time.

name: Ammonite Chronicle
description: A data story of ammonite fossils across geological eras. A radial timeline arranges specimens, diversity charts and strata into one dark, gilded composition.

name: Fossil Paths
description: The making of a fossil, drawn as a winding path. Each stage from death and burial to mineralization and exposure becomes a station along the line, ending with the odds of survival.

name: Solar Terms
description: Twenty-four solar terms reimagined as character illustrations. Palettes, materials and seasonal motifs keep the series coherent while each season changes its mood.

name: Ceremony Pavilion
description: A round ritual pavilion for a wedding ceremony space. A thin white roof floats above paired columns, keeping the interior open to the sky, the water and the seats below.

name: Model Pavilion
description: A hand-built octagonal pavilion model at small scale. Bamboo sticks, paper and painted ground test the structure and its proportions before the digital version is finalized.

name: Silo Stories
description: An information experience for a repurposed grain warehouse. Wayfinding, layered narratives and a mini-program guide visitors through the silo and its changing uses.

name: Taste of Wuhan
description: A food map of Wuhan built from collected restaurant data. An interactive web map pairs geocoded spots with a 3D city view and ranks the breakfast icons of the river city.

name: Blooming Code
description: Generative flower rings drawn in Processing. Noise and trigonometry pulse each ring so the whole garden drifts between order and randomness.

name: Street Furniture
description: A field study of bus stop benches across cities. Photos and sketches compare climate, material and policy, tracing how one public seat reflects each city.

name: Machine Collage
description: A surreal machine assembled in Unreal Engine. Floors, cranes and towers interlock at impossible angles, testing scale, silhouette and light in a single scene.

name: Glow Cradle
description: A physical computing piece. A translucent figure breathes with a red heartbeat, its LED and sensors responding to serial input from the connected control program.

name: Outing Bunny
description: A travel-day character illustration. A rabbit-eared hiker poses with tanghulu on a mountain meadow, with flat shapes and a soft palette keeping the scene light.

name: Frame Studies
description: A character design sheet moving from skeleton to silhouette to color. Stages of the same pose show how structure supports the energy of the final drawing.
